entry.title: What If Your Crush Was a Tsundere?

media:group.media:title: What If Your Crush Was a Tsundere?
media:group.media:description:
Her mouth says no. Her ears say otherwise.
Hana Kim calls you an idiot four times a day. She also makes you bento, drew you 40 times in a secret sketchbook, and leaves your favorite drink in vending machine B7 every morning at 7:58. You think she hates you. Everyone else in school has a bet on when you'll notice.
So what happens when your crush is a tsundere?

entry.title: What If You Had Infinite IQ and Built a Kingdom?

media:group.media:title: What If You Had Infinite IQ and Built a Kingdom?
media:group.media:description: You wake up in a ditch with two moons overhead and a goose standing on your chest. No name. No class. Your IQ doesn't have a number. Forty outcasts in a cursed valley. Two dwarf smiths the Guild threw out. A knight who said no. A hunter who shot at you. Marta, who is sure the whole place is cursed. And Bram, a farmhand with a goose named Duchess. You fix the soil, rebuild Roman concrete, beat a salt blockade and stop an army of four thousand with a dam, mud and bread. It turns out infinite IQ doesn't build a kingdom. It just makes you smart enough to notice who can. ⏱ Chapters 0:00 Twelve thousand people clap for you 0:55 The ditch, two moons and a goose 2:27 The Dead Valley 3:46 Dwarfs, a cart and the forest 5:13 Ser Aldric 6:20 Baron Vask and 300 riders 7:40 Lanterns at midnight 8:37 Roman concrete and a new town 9:46 The Salt Guild 10:54 The machine and the festival 11:57 The round table 13:18 The Empire of Kael 14:14 The plan, together 15:22 The siege 16:16 The battle at the old ford 17:45 The speech With ∞ IQ, what would you build first? entry.title: What If Your Crush Was a Yandere?

media:group.media:title: What If Your Crush Was a Yandere?
media:group.media:description:
She shared your earbud on the bus. Then she reorganized your locker, changed your password, and made you three lunches a day.
What if the girl you liked liked you back… a little too much?
This is the story of Mika: sweet, perfect, and completely obsessed. From the first earbud to 1,100 secret photos, a Valentine's dance that almost went very wrong, and what it really means to be loved instead of kept.
Being kept means you can't leave. Being loved means you can, and you don't.
So if someone loved you this much… would you run? Or would you stay? Tell us in the comments.

If something in a relationship feels controlling, talk to someone you trust: a friend, a parent, or a school counselor.

entry.title: What If You Could Hypnotize Anyone?

media:group.media:title: What If You Could Hypnotize Anyone?
media:group.media:description:
What if one snap of your fingers made anyone do exactly what you say?
You fail a math exam… snap… and the teacher gives you an A+. Free fries. Rent paid. A brand-new phone. The girl you like holding your hand. For 30 days, the whole world says yes to you.
But a yes only means something when someone could have said no.
In this animated story we explore what hypnosis really is, what Stanford researchers found when they scanned hypnotized brains, why only about 1 in 10 people are highly hypnotizable, and what happens to friendship, family and love when nobody can refuse you.
Who would YOU snap at first? Tell us in the comments 👇

entry.title: ​What If the Entire World Hunted You with Infinite IQ?

media:group.media:title: ​What If the Entire World Hunted You with Infinite IQ?
media:group.media:description:
With $200 of birthday money, you build a trading bot that makes $2,000,000. Then a billionaire steals it, runs it with $50 billion… and crashes the world's markets at 2:32 p.m.
Everyone blames you.
41 countries want you arrested. A private $500,000,000 reward is on your head. Drones over your house. Hunters on every corner.
But you have infinite IQ.
So you don't run. You hide in the one place nobody checks, set traps, fool everyone, get yourself arrested on purpose… and make the whole world chase you exactly where you want it.
⏱ Chapters 0:00 The jump 0:50 $200 and a laptop 1:34 The crash 2:40 Hiding in plain sight 3:37 The napkin trick 4:50 Crane Tower 5:34 One second 6:18 Arrested on purpose 6:54 The auction 8:00 Pancakes
Would you run… or make them chase you exactly where you wanted? Tell me in the comments 👇
Inspired by real events: on May 6, 2010, automated trading helped wipe out about a trillion dollars of market value in minutes, then most of it came back the same afternoon.

entry.title: What If You Were Stuck in a Car With Your Crush?

media:group.media:title: What If You Were Stuck in a Car With Your Crush?
media:group.media:description:
What if a blizzard trapped you in a car with the person you've liked for two years… and your phone held a "grocery list" that is very much not a grocery list?
Three days. One car. One blanket that smells like your dog. And half a jar of Grandma's pickles.
Real science in this story: • Carbon monoxide: why a buried tailpipe is deadly, and why rescuers say to clear it every hour • Arthur Aron's 36 Questions (1997): how strangers become close in 45 minutes • The Capilano Suspension Bridge study (Vancouver, 1974): why fear can feel like a crush
If you were stuck with your crush, what's the first thing you'd say? Tell us in the comments.

entry.title: What If You Got 1$ Every Time Your Crush Loughed?

media:group.media:title: What If You Got 1$ Every Time Your Crush Loughed?
media:group.media:description:

media:group.media:title: What If You Had 1000 Charisma?
media:group.media:description:
What if you had 1000 charisma?
You say "hey" to a stranger on a plane, and the whole cabin falls in love with you. One word from you, and people give you their bread, their cars, their companies. A stadium cancels a match. A city stops sleeping. Generals lean in, waiting for you to speak.
Every word you say becomes an order. Everyone says yes.
Except one person: your neighbour in 4B. She won't look at you. She won't talk to you. She only writes notes. And every note says NO.
Then the whole world tunes in to hear you speak, and you have one word that could end a war forever.
So if the whole world would say yes to anything you asked… what would you ask it?

entry.title: What If Only You Had Testosterone?

media:group.media:title: What If Only You Had Testosterone?
media:group.media:description:
At 3:47 this morning, every man on Earth lost his testosterone. Three point eight billion men. Gone. Overnight. Except you.
Over the next forty days the world becomes quieter, kinder and safer than it has ever been. Wars end on a Thursday. Prisons go silent. Hospitals have empty beds for the first time in history. And humanity quietly runs out of time.
You are the only one who can bring it all back — the babies, and the bar fights. The road rage. The wars. So if it were your blood… which world would you choose?
Tell us in the comments: kind and ending, or cruel and continuing?
